message.content:
In a standard 5‑card hand from a 52‑card deck, the probability of being dealt a full house (three cards of one rank and two cards of another rank) is:

\[
P(\text{full house}) = \frac{3744}{\binom{52}{5}} \approx 0.001440576 \;\text{or}\; 0.144\%
\]

So roughly 1 in 694 hands will be a full house.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the probability of getting a full house in poker?" They want the probability. We can compute it. The default deck_size=52, hand_size=5. So we need to calculate probability of full house in 5-card poker. That is known: 3744 / C(52,5) = 3744/2598960 ≈ 0.001440576. So probability ~0.00144 or about 0.144%. We can provide that. No tool needed.
